title: Reproducible experiment
prompt:
Track versions, parameters, and results.

Task: A repeatable experiment record with lineage.

Use synthetic or approved local data only. Your response should describe inputs, decisions, and the evidence needed to trust the result.

starter.starter:
# Reproducible experiment
# Describe your method, evidence, expected output, and limitations.

public_tests.name: Basic response gate
public_tests.note: This automated check validates selected required terms only; a human reviewer must assess correctness and completeness.

acceptance_criteria: Explain how another learner can reproduce or audit the run.
Provide a reproducible result, query, calculation, or reviewable workflow.
Record at least one assumption, limitation, data-quality check, or failure mode.
hints: Log code/data version, configuration, seed, metrics, and artifact path.
Define the input data grain and the expected result before writing the solution.
Use the official documentation for current tool syntax; a keyword-based grader is not a proof of correctness.

retry_policy.guidance: Use the feedback to revise. A completed activity may receive platform-standard XP only once; course content does not assign or override XP.

expected_output: A repeatable experiment record with lineage.
status_note: Draft exercise mapped to Data Science.pdf Section C item 26. This basic server-side grader is a submission gate, not a subject-matter assessment.
